fusions.name: Spreading Reef
fusions.desc: Casts a coral-crusted link at the first enemy it meets for 12 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Barnacle Rasp
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 7 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Living Moorings
fusions.desc: Grows a reef of living links around you for 8 seconds; it restores 3 health a second to you and every ally within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Slow Accretion
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
